description: A Tampermonkey/Violentmonkey user script for Zapia Chat: managed title prefixes, guarded bulk and current-chat actions, configurable shortcuts.

userStories.title: Manage Zapia chats with labels, deletion and keyboard shortcuts
userStories.description: As a Zapia user, I can prefix and delete selected visible chats in bulk and act on the current chat through configurable keyboard shortcuts.
acceptanceCriteria: Targets https://app.zapia.com/chat only.
Adds ✔ and 🟡 prefix actions without stacking or duplicating managed prefixes; both emojis are configurable.
Provides a selectable searchable catalogue in the native sidebar area; US-006 supersedes the original floating panel and launcher.
Deletion opens Zapia's native flow and confirms it only inside the visible `Excluir conversa?` dialog, one chat at a time.
Defaults `Alt+Shift+C`, `Alt+Shift+Y` and `Alt+Shift+X` prefix with ✔, prefix with 🟡 and delete the current chat; the settings dialog captures and validates new chords.
Shortcuts do not intercept typing or repeated keydown events.
Native menu actions are matched by exact label (`Renomear`/`Excluir`), never by free text.
Tests cover prefix replacement, row discovery, selection, native-delete exclusions, chord parsing and validation.
userStories.notes: Delivered through 0.2.26; 16 Node tests passed at that point.

userStories.title: Exclude Zapia navigation banners from the manager chat list
userStories.description: As a Zapia user, I only see real chats in the manager panel, so no panel action can click a promo or navigation banner.
acceptanceCriteria: `Ganhe o Zapia Pro de graça` (with or without its `Nova função disponível` suffix) is never listed as a chat.
The chat viewport starts below that banner.
A similarly worded chat title such as `Ganhe tempo com o Zapia Pro` is still treated as a chat.
Live Chrome check: the banner is present in the sidebar and absent from the panel list.
userStories.notes: 0.2.27 adds PROMO_NAVIGATION_PATTERN to isNavigationActionLabel and to the viewport top calculation. 17 Node tests pass. Live check in the authenticated automation Chrome: sidebar text still contained the banner, panel list showed 8 real chats and no banner.

userStories.title: Keep the manager panel from covering Zapia's native chat menu
userStories.description: As a Zapia user, the native `Informações do chat / Renomear / Fixar / Reportar / Excluir` menu stays visible when it opens.
acceptanceCriteria: While the native menu is open, the panel does not overlap its area (top right under the header action).
The panel position is restored when the menu closes.
Verified visually in the authenticated Chrome with a screenshot.
userStories.notes: 0.2.28 hides the panel (visibility hidden, pointer-events none) while an exact `Renomear` item inside a role=group node exists, and restores it when the menu closes. 18 Node tests pass. Live authenticated Chrome: real click on the header menu button showed the native menu fully visible with the panel hidden; a click outside closed it and the panel returned (visibility visible). Screenshots taken.

userStories.title: Find why a shortcut sometimes opens a chat link
userStories.description: As a Zapia user, pressing a current-chat shortcut never opens a link from the chat.
acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce in a chat whose message area contains a link, or prove the script cannot trigger it.
Fix the root cause, with a regression test when it is testable outside the browser.
userStories.notes: Blocked on a repro. 15 chats exposed one `Mais ações` and no link nodes; Alt+C produced only `Mais ações` then `Renomear` clicks. Message bodies do not render in the automation Chrome. Needs from the user: which shortcut, link domain, same or new tab, mouse position. Update 2026-10-17: messages now render in the automation Chrome and a chat with a link exists (`Abra o roteiro no Google Docs`, chat `[2] Capítulo de Larissa...`), so a repro attempt is possible.

userStories.title: Search and filter the full chat catalogue with fast browser iteration
userStories.description: As a Zapia user, I can find all loaded sidebar chats using browser find and filters; development reloads replace only the userscript without reloading Zapia or repeating the catalogue scan.
acceptanceCriteria: Scan the native sidebar to both ends and render complete discovered chat titles as real DOM text.
Filter by leading [number], configured emoji 1 and configured emoji 2, including checkmark variation selectors; combined filters use OR.
Selected offscreen chats can be revealed before invoking native actions; filter changes discard hidden selections.
Userscript replacement disposes its timers, listeners and observers while preserving loaded chats, filters, selection and panel scroll.
A single canonical development command reloads the local source into the exact authenticated CDP tab without page navigation or a repeated scan.
Browser evidence covers text search, filters and repeated hot replacement; syntax and behavioral tests pass.
userStories.notes: 0.3.0. Explicit two-direction sidebar traversal discovered 113 unique chats in 12.786 s. Browser smoke verified 5 numbered, 56 emoji-1 and 24 emoji-2 matches; OR filtering and hidden-selection removal; DOM text search reached an offscreen panel title. Repeated source-only replacement preserved catalogue, filters, selection and scroll, retained one keyboard listener/panel/style, and disposed all old owned resources. Final replacement took 57 ms with no document reload or scan. An offscreen selected chat reached its own rename dialog via the header menu; save was blocked and the dialog cancelled. Syntax checks and 23 Node tests passed. Local sanitized evidence: .context/workflow/ralph/evidence/us-005.json. The injector updates the current page, not the extension installation.

userStories.title: Integrate the searchable catalogue into the native sidebar area
userStories.description: As a Zapia user, I use one seamlessly styled sidebar rather than a separate floating manager. The user accepts a DOM catalogue replacing the Canvas chat-list area while preserving native navigation and profile.
acceptanceCriteria: No manager panel or launcher remains on the right; catalogue bounds stay inside the native sidebar between primary navigation and profile.
Full DOM titles, numeric/emoji filters, selection, settings and configured shortcuts remain available.
Clicking a title opens its native chat; a row action opens the correct native menu. Native sidebar navigation is returned to the top after reveal or refresh.
Main chat content, native navigation, profile and right-hand native menu are not covered.
Live browser checks cover layout, filters, browser text find and navigation before updating Tampermonkey.
The validated version is saved in Tampermonkey, verified from its dashboard/editor after reopening, and checked on a freshly loaded Zapia page.
userStories.notes: Delivered in 0.4.0. Live CDP smoke covered 113 chats, numeric/emoji filters, offscreen DOM text find, native title navigation including an offscreen source row, active highlighting, native menu coexistence and focused/frame-settled Escape dismissal, checkbox/settings isolation, and native search restoration. Sidebar bounds were x=0..280, y=286..762.667 with native navigation/profile preserved; no floating panel/launcher remained. Syntax and 25 Node tests passed. Tampermonkey saved one enabled Zapia Manager 0.4.0; after reloading its dashboard and reopening the editor, persisted source matched the validated file exactly. A fresh Zapia page automatically started 0.4.0 with 113 chats, one integrated sidebar, a non-overlapping native menu and no page errors. No chat data was changed. Local sanitized evidence: .context/workflow/ralph/evidence/us-006.json.

userStories.title: Add persistent catalogue priorities and protect reusable agents
userStories.description: Advanced optional catalogue rules preserve native pinning and ordering while protecting chats marked with the configured agent emoji from Manager deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: Four independent persisted controls are accessible in the integrated sidebar: prioritize agents, prioritize pending numeric IDs, hide completed, and only unprefixed.
Pinned membership is collected from native sidebar structure, never inferred from titles or catalogue position.
With both priorities enabled use pinned, agents, pending IDs, remainder; preserve native order inside each group and never duplicate chats.
Completed numeric IDs receive no ID priority. Hide completed also hides pinned completed chats.
Only unprefixed preserves surviving pinned chats, then allows only titles without numeric ID or either managed emoji; it overrides both promotion rules.
All options off preserves native order. Existing emoji/id filters, text search, selection, native navigation and settings remain usable.
Manager buttons and shortcuts cannot delete agents. Mixed selections skip protected agents while safely retaining eligible entries; recheck the real native title before any delete action.
Syntax, Node behavior tests and authenticated CDP smoke cover combinations, pinning and guarded deletion without deleting real chats.
After live validation save the release in Tampermonkey; compare reopened persisted source and verify automatic startup and preferences on a fresh Zapia page.
Update Graphify, canonical context and evidence; clean owned temporary artifacts and commit the cohesive change.
userStories.notes: Delivered in 0.5.1 and refined in 0.5.3. Live CDP smoke covered 113 chats, the catalogue view rules, structural pinned recognition, immediate chat pruning on deletion (withoutChatId), dedicated row menu dropdown directly beneath the 3 dots of each chat row (Renomear, ✔ Prefixar, 🟡 Prefixar, Excluir), default Alt+C/Alt+Y/Alt+X shortcuts with backward-compatible Alt+Shift chords, single-script Tampermonkey installation, and 0.5.3 UI enhancements: panel minimize/expand toggle (-/+), gear settings button (⚙), quick blank unprefixed filter button to the left of [nº], and right-aligned refresh button (↻). All 33 Node tests pass.
